subject: U1: lib/workspace-registry.js — repoRoot resolver + v1→v2 migration + addRepo + reverse index
description:
Create NEW module lib/workspace-registry.js as the SINGLE source of truth for workspace↔repo resolution. No other file should readFileSync(WORKSPACES_FILE) directly after this.

Exports required:
- repoRoot(startDir): walk UP from startDir to the nearest ancestor dir containing `.graph` OR `.git` (prefer `.graph`). In git worktrees `.git` is a FILE (gitdir pointer) — treat that as "this is a repo" but resolve to the dir holding it. EXCLUDE attempt/feature worktrees exactly like routes/meta.js:240 already does (do not let a worktree register itself as a new workspace). Return the dir or null.
- loadRegistry(file): read+parse WORKSPACES_FILE. SCHEMA v2 = { version:2, workspaces: { [name]: { repos: string[] } } }. MIGRATION: if parsed value is an Array<string> (v1 flat), wrap each path as its own single-repo workspace { version:2, workspaces: { [basename(p)]: { repos:[p] } } }, with basename-collision suffix `-<shorthash>` reusing the overlay naming convention (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/overlay/<name>-<hash>.json). Persist migrated form back ATOMICALLY (write a one-shot .bak of the original before first rewrite). Garbage/missing → { version:2, workspaces:{} }. Must be idempotent.
- allRepos(reg): flat de-duped array of every member repo path across all workspaces (this is what registeredWorkspaces() will consume — it MUST keep yielding a flat list of repo paths).
- repoToWorkspace(reg): derived reverse Map<repoPath, workspaceName> (first-writer-wins on dup).
- addRepo(file, { workspace, repo }): register repo under a named workspace (create the workspace if new); atomic write; idempotent (no dup repos).

Use graph-store's atomic-write style (do NOT add a new write primitive). Pure-Node, dependency-free, must be require-able from daemon.js, hooks/*.js, and the CLI.

ALSO create test/workspace-registry.test.js: unit-test repoRoot (walk-up, .graph vs .git, worktree gitdir-FILE case, exclusion of attempt/feature worktrees), loadRegistry v1→v2 migration (seed a flat array, assert v2 out + .bak written + idempotent re-load), addRepo idempotency, repoToWorkspace reverse index. Follow the existing test style (no framework; node test/...; PASS/FAIL counters like test/per-repo-workspace-scoping.test.js).

This unit is fully backward-compatible and introduces NO behavior change on its own — it is the foundation U2–U6 import. Land it first.
